context.passage:
To:
All employees
From: Patricia Ogdencort, CEO
Date:
22 June
Subject: Company-wide discussion
Here at Ogdencort, we believe in partnering with our employees to make
positive changes. — [1] -. As such, we would like one representative from
each department to participate in company-wide discussions on reducing
costs.
Employees interested in serving as a representative must have worked at
Ogdencort for a minimum of one year. - (2) —. Also, they must have
received positive performance reviews and must be able to attend four
meetings during one calendar year. Department heads are asked to
withhold from serving as representatives. Please submit your name for
consideration to your department head no later than 20 August. - [3]-.
Successful applicants will be notified within one week of the deadline.
We will also be creating a suggestion box. - (4] -. Further information
will be provided soon.
